machine: Modal L4 GPU container, 4 vCPU, 16 GiB (gpu=L4, cpu=4, memory=16384)
questions: 224 documentation questions; recall/MRR over the 205 a user should get an answer to (not_in_docs and refused permission questions are scored on the answer, not on retrieval)
k_note: Each config is searched once with k=10; recall@3/@5 are read off the same ranking, so latency is the k=10 search.
rewrite_note: Query rewriting latency = the recorded LLM call (gemini-3.8-flash via OpenRouter), added to the measured retrieval.
pruning: none for retrieval: every chunking x model x retrieval x reranker x rewriting was measured (2112 rows x 3 k values); answers were generated only for the configs in rag_answers_*.json
